_comment: Quality-gate registry. Read by ledger.mjs (task completion) and record-gate.mjs (PostToolUse evidence). Commands were derived from the real repo: backend/pytest.ini (testpaths=tests, asyncio_mode=auto), frontend/package.json scripts, frontend/tests/loader.mjs, AGENTS.md section 6. Status values: EXECUTABLE (command exists and ran in the validation exercise), CONFIGURED (command exists, not yet run here), BLOCKED (needs an approval or an install first), NOT-CONFIGURED (no tool exists in the repo; none is invented).

pytest_base.note: Local interpreter is Python 3.14; backend/Dockerfile uses python:3.11-slim. A local pass does not prove 3.11 compatibility.

gates.name: Backend import and collection sanity
gates.pass: exit 0 and a collected-test count with no collection errors

gates.name: Full backend suite
gates.trigger: any change under backend/app, before final acceptance of a run, any HIGH-risk task
gates.pass: 0 failed, 0 errors; passed count > 0. Project rule (AGENTS.md section 2): 100 percent of tests passing
gates.on_fail: NEEDS_FIX; never weaken or skip a test to pass

gates.name: Authentication, JWT and tenant isolation regressions
gates.trigger: backend/app/core/security.py, backend/app/api/**, any get_current_user_id usage, tenant scoping code
gates.command: cd backend && py -m pytest tests/test_jwt_security.py tests/test_p0_security_remediation.py tests/test_tenant_correlation_remediation.py -q
gates.on_fail: NEEDS_FIX; a failing auth test is a security finding, escalate to security-auditor

gates.name: Stripe and Shopify webhook verification, replay and idempotency
gates.command: cd backend && py -m pytest tests/test_stripe_webhook_security.py tests/test_failover_webhooks.py tests/test_shopify_lifecycle_webhooks.py tests/test_shopify_compliance.py tests/test_failover_idempotency_p2.py -q
gates.on_fail: NEEDS_FIX; never relax signature verification to pass

gates.name: Billing plan, entitlement and privilege enforcement
gates.trigger: billing, tier_guards, plan or quota code, profile billing columns
gates.command: cd backend && py -m pytest tests/test_billing.py tests/test_billing_and_security.py tests/test_shopify_billing.py tests/test_shopify_billing_security.py tests/test_profile_billing_privilege_remediation.py tests/test_ai_plan_policy.py tests/test_domain_quota_concurrency.py -q
gates.pass: 0 failed, 0 errors; no paid-feature or enterprise bypass test weakened

gates.name: Abuse protection: rate limits, SSRF-safe fetch, input limits, safe errors
gates.trigger: rate_limiter, safe fetcher, request models, settings or alert endpoints, main.py middleware
gates.command: cd backend && py -m pytest tests/test_rate_limiter_forensics.py tests/test_phase2_1_remediation.py tests/test_safe_http_fetcher.py tests/test_settings_and_alert_security.py tests/test_telegram_client_hardening.py -q

gates.name: Background workers: leases, retries, duplicate protection, shutdown, recovery
gates.trigger: backend/app/workers/**, outbox or lease code, failover worker, scheduler
gates.command: cd backend && py -m pytest tests/test_audit_leases.py tests/test_durable_notification_outbox.py tests/test_failover_worker_safety.py tests/test_failover_worker_step5.py tests/test_delivery_failure_retry_contract.py tests/test_workers.py tests/test_worker_env_guard.py tests/test_worker_import_regression.py tests/test_staging_worker_isolation.py tests/test_scheduler_and_alerts.py tests/test_p1_operational_remediation.py -q
gates.on_fail: NEEDS_FIX; tests that pin claim or lease semantics must not be edited to match a regression

gates.name: Migration and RLS static safety
gates.pass: scan reports 0 blocking findings (no DROP TABLE/DATABASE, TRUNCATE, unguarded DELETE, DISABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY, DROP POLICY, broad GRANT to anon/PUBLIC, USING (true)); ledger test passes; database-engineer and security-auditor review recorded
gates.on_fail: NEEDS_FIX. Applying any migration to any database is NOT autonomous
gates.limitation: main has no live-Postgres harness (no backend/tests/integration). RLS enforcement and cross-tenant access cannot be proven by an automated gate here; only static review plus app-level tenant tests exist.

gates.name: Secret and dangerous-pattern scan of the working-tree diff
gates.pass: exit 0; zero blocking findings (values are never printed)
gates.on_fail: NEEDS_FIX; if a real secret was written, STOP and report to the user

gates.name: Diff within approved Change Set
gates.trigger: every task before acceptance and at final report
gates.pass: exit 0: every changed or untracked repo file matches allowed_paths and no forbidden_paths
gates.on_fail: STOP: out-of-scope change; do not revert user files, report to the user

gates.name: Frontend unit tests
gates.trigger: any change under frontend/src or frontend/tests
gates.limitation: Source: AGENTS.md section 6. frontend/node_modules is absent in this checkout, so whether the tests run without an install is UNVERIFIED until executed.

gates.name: Frontend type check
gates.limitation: Requires node_modules (absent). Installing dependencies is outside this mission and needs explicit user approval.

gates.name: Frontend production build
gates.trigger: any change under frontend/src, before final acceptance of frontend work
gates.pass: build exits 0 with 0 TypeScript and webpack errors (AGENTS.md section 2)
gates.limitation: Requires node_modules (absent) and may need public env names; never use production values.

gates.name: Container build and health probes
gates.trigger: Dockerfile, docker-compose.yml or runtime configuration changes
gates.command: docker compose build (then docker compose up + /health and /ready probes)
gates.limitation: Starting containers can read local .env values and bind ports; requires explicit user approval each time. /ready readiness semantics are unverified.

gates.name: Backend lint and type check
gates.limitation: No ruff, mypy, flake8 or pyproject configuration exists in backend/ and none is installed. No command is invented; code-reviewer covers style.

gates.name: Independent code review
gates.pass: verdict APPROVE with no Critical or Required findings, after the last edit

gates.name: Independent security review
gates.trigger: HIGH risk tasks and every task touching a security boundary
gates.pass: no Critical or High findings, every finding independently checked by the orchestrator, after the last edit
gates.on_fail: NEEDS_FIX; ambiguous security decisions STOP the run

gates.name: Test adequacy review
gates.pass: no Critical coverage gap for the changed behavior, new behavior has a test that fails without the change

_risk_note: Area-specific gates (G-AUTH-JWT, G-WEBHOOKS, G-BILLING, G-ABUSE, G-WORKER, G-MIGRATION-STATIC, G-FE-*) are added per task in the Change Set via the task's gates list, using the trigger column. A task is HIGH when any of its files matches boundaries.json security_boundaries.
